summary: Iteration 7 full-stack testing (TTS voice, trips lifecycle, pace learning, same-side rest areas, repeat route, navigation). Backend: 15/15 new tests in test_iteration7.py pass. POST /api/tts generates mp3 via Emergent OpenAI TTS and caches by sha256 key (same text returns same key quickly). GET /api/tts/{key}.mp3 returns 200 audio/mpeg with cache header. Invalid hex and non-hex keys return 404. Empty text returns 422. Trips: POST /api/trips -> 201 with status in_progress and null actual_s. POST /finish with arrived=true and driven_km>=0.8*distance sets actual_s=moving_s and actual_source=gps. simulated=true -> actual_s stays null and simulated persists. PATCH /actual sets manual source and returns pace. GET /api/trips returns {trips, pace{factor, trips_used}}. DELETE -> 204. Other-user trip -> 404 for both DELETE and finish. Pace learning: after 3 trips with ratio 1.15 on Madrid->BCN @40t, pace_factor landed at 1.09 (expected shrinkage weight 0.6 over median 1.15), pace_trips=3, truck_duration_s == base * pace_factor. Same-side rest areas: Madrid->BCN produced zero 'left' side areas and no 'Sentido Zaragoza' names. Trips cleaned up afterwards so pace returned to {factor:1, trips_used:0}. Frontend (viewport 390x844): auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit login OK; tab-map, open-trips-btn opens trips-sheet; trips-pace renders ('Aún sin viajes para aprender tu ritmo' when empty). trip-card-0 visible; trip-edit-actual-0 -> trip-actual-input-0 '4:15' -> trip-actual-save-0 updates trip-actual-0 to 'Real 4h 15m (manual)'. trip-repeat-0 closes sheet and auto-calculates the route (route-summary visible, origin-input='Madrid'). start-navigation-btn opens navigate-screen; nav-voice-toggle present and toggles; nav-exit-btn returns to map-bottom-sheet. Starting navigation creates a Madrid->Barcelona trip in Rutas anteriores correctly marked simulated=true (web demo mode). ONE web-only bug: after nav-exit, Expo shows an Uncaught Error 'The wake lock with tag _r_0_ has not activated yet' coming from expo-keep-awake (navigate.tsx:6,35) because the browser never granted the wake lock and the hook's cleanup still attempts to release it. This does not affect native builds, but it currently crashes the web preview session after returning from navigation.

integration_issues.issue: After pressing nav-exit-btn, Expo red screen shows 'Uncaught Error: The wake lock with tag _r_0_ has not activated yet'. Triggered by useKeepAwake() unmount cleanup when the browser never granted a wake lock. Reference: /app/frontend/app/navigate.tsx:6 (import), :35 (useKeepAwake()). Suggested fix: guard with Platform.OS !== 'web' or use useKeepAwake(tag, { suppressErrorOnWeb: true }) / try/catch inside a custom hook.

rca_of_issue: Wake-lock error RCA: expo-keep-awake uses the browser Screen Wake Lock API on web. The lock often fails to activate silently (requires user gesture + visibility) but the hook still schedules a release on unmount; the release promise rejects with 'The wake lock with tag <tag> has not activated yet'. Reproduce: login -> tab-map -> calculate any route -> start-navigation-btn -> nav-exit-btn. Mitigation (one-liner): `if (Platform.OS !== 'web') useKeepAwake();` is not valid (hook rule) - use a thin wrapper: `function useKeepAwakeSafe(){ if(Platform.OS==='web') return; useKeepAwake(); }` and call it unconditionally, or wrap deactivation in try/catch via activateKeepAwakeAsync/deactivateKeepAwake in a useEffect guarded by Platform.OS.
